preconditions.description: Input constraints: number of cities (n), roads (m), and capital index (s) must be within specified bounds.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u_i <= n and 1 <= v_i <= n and u_i != v_i for u_i, v_i in roads)
preconditions.description: Each road connects two distinct cities within the valid range.
The number of roads provided matches the input value m.

postconditions.description: The output is the minimum number of new roads required to make all cities reachable from the capital s.
The minimum number of roads is equal to the number of strongly connected components (or unreachable components) that are not reachable from the capital s.

postconditions.expression: min_roads == 0 if all(city_reachable(city, s, roads) for city in range(1, n + 1)) else min_roads >= 1
postconditions.description: If all cities are already reachable from s, the output is 0; otherwise, the output is at least 1.
